name: GrowthHive Dark Mode
author: growthhive

sections.description:
GrowthHive is a modern Dark Mode plugin that lets visitors and administrators switch between light and dark themes instantly. It works with virtually any WordPress theme without requiring custom CSS or coding.

Whether you’re improving user comfort, reducing eye strain, or giving your website a modern appearance, GrowthHive provides an elegant, lightweight, and performance-friendly solution.

Why Choose GrowthHive?

  • One-click installation
  • No coding required
  • Lightweight and optimized for speed
  • Works with almost every WordPress theme
  • Fully responsive
  • Accessibility friendly
  • Easy customization

  • One-Click Dark Mode
  • Frontend Dark Mode
  • WordPress Admin Dark Mode
  • Floating Toggle Button
  • Light & Dark Theme Switch
  • Toggle Position Settings
  • Multiple Toggle Icons

sections.installation:
1. Upload the growthhive-dark-mode folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to GrowthHive from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enable Dark Mode and customize the settings.
sections.faq:
Does GrowthHive work with every WordPress theme?

Yes. GrowthHive is designed to work with most WordPress themes automatically without requiring custom CSS.

Does it support the WordPress admin dashboard?

Yes. You can enable Dark Mode for the WordPress admin area independently.

Can users switch between Light and Dark mode?

Yes. Visitors can easily switch between light and dark mode using the floating toggle button.

Can I customize the toggle button?

Yes. You can customize:

  • Position
  • Size
  • Icon
  • Text
  • Colors

Is the plugin mobile friendly?

Yes. GrowthHive works perfectly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Will Dark Mode slow down my website?

No. GrowthHive is lightweight and optimized for performance.
